</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

This leads to delays in reporting and uncertainty over which figures are accurate.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Finance teams at customer companies are directly questioning the data and experiencing reporting delays [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed].\n- Account managers and support teams are fielding questions and troubleshooting the mismatch, as indicated by mentions from the account_management and support routes [i:4a12350cd4d4f040][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc].\n- Users attempting to export data are encountering technical errors, as shown by session logs [i:2a7e1476a88e0d6b][i:605237c4f13ef789].\n\n## Evidence\nThe issue has been reported by 7 accounts, representing a total ARR of £7,050,000 [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed]. There have been 16 total mentions of the problem across 4 different routes: 9 from support, 3 from account_management, 3 from sessions, and 1 from sales [i:4a12350cd4d4f040][i:69ced11dd0bfa22c][i:2a7e1476a88e0d6b].\n\nCustomers report that finance teams are comparing dashboard totals with exported CSV files and finding them off, which causes confusion and distrust in the numbers used for monthly reporting [i:551e3ef68cf180fa][i:79dbb87fe13aebb4]. A customer from Tidewell Marine & Cargo stated, Finance is questioning which figure is correct because the export doesn’t match the dashboard [i:2e7168b298e234f6]. Another from Marrowgate Commercial noted the mismatch is consistent with UTC cutoff, not UK time [i:ccfc25a70dd3f36d]. The problem leads to operational delays, as an insight notes the export figures mismatch is causing delays in our month-end close [i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed].\n\n## Why now\nThree of the affected accounts have renewals due within the next 90 days as of 2026-10-01 [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed]. Stannary Commercial (ARR £540,000) renews on 2026-12-05, Ashcombe Property Mutual (ARR £250,000) on 2026-11-30, and Marrowgate Commercial (ARR £1,600,000) on 2026-12-12 [i:1258088ddf027b73][i:ccfc25a70dd3f36d]. The volume of recent reports is significant, with mentions occurring in September and October 2026 [i:4c1e1128bbb746cc][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed]. This concentration of feedback coincides with the critical month-end and quarter-end financial reporting cycles, where data accuracy is paramount.",

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the headline numbers (7 accounts, £7,050,000 ARR, 16 mentions across 4 routes with 9 support / 3 account_management / 3 sessions / 1 sales) against the fact sheet and they all match exactly. The quoted Tidewell Marine & Cargo statement is a verbatim match to insight 2e7168b298e234f6, and the Marrowgate UTC-cutoff point is a fair paraphrase of ccfc25a70dd3f36d (not in quotation marks). The three renewals named (Stannary 2026-12-05, Ashcombe 2026-11-30, Marrowgate 2026-12-12) are indeed the only accounts with renewals within 90 days of 2026-10-01 per the fact sheet. Every claim is tied to a cited insight or the fact sheet, with no overstated scope or omitted contrary evidence found.", "verdict": "pass"}
